qa.name: Supraspinatus
qa.insertion: Superior facet of the greater tubercle of the humerus
qa.function: Initiates abduction of the arm (first 15 degrees), assists deltoid in full abduction
qa.opposing_muscle: Adductors of the shoulder (Pectoralis Major, Latissimus Dorsi)
qa.rotator_cuff_role: Stabilizes humeral head in glenoid fossa during arm movement
qa.clinical_note: Most commonly torn rotator cuff muscle; tested by empty-can (Jobe) test

qa.name: Infraspinatus
qa.insertion: Middle facet of the greater tubercle of the humerus
qa.function: Lateral (external) rotation of the arm; stabilizes glenohumeral joint
qa.rotator_cuff_role: Primary external rotator; resists anterior dislocation of humeral head
qa.clinical_note: Tested by external rotation against resistance with elbow at 90 degrees

qa.name: Teres Minor
qa.origin: Lateral border of the scapula (upper two-thirds)
qa.insertion: Inferior facet of the greater tubercle of the humerus
qa.function: Lateral (external) rotation of the arm; adduction of the arm
qa.blood_supply: Posterior circumflex humeral artery, Circumflex scapular artery
qa.rotator_cuff_role: Assists infraspinatus in external rotation; stabilizes humeral head
qa.clinical_note: Different nerve than other rotator cuff muscles — axillary nerve, not suprascapular

qa.name: Subscapularis
qa.origin: Subscapular fossa of the scapula (anterior surface)
qa.function: Medial (internal) rotation of the arm; adduction of the arm
qa.rotator_cuff_role: Only anterior rotator cuff muscle; resists posterior dislocation of humeral head
qa.clinical_note: Only rotator cuff muscle that inserts on the lesser tubercle; tested by lift-off (Gerber) test and belly-press test
